summary: Mixed legal and retail day: Supreme Court proposes investment platform for court deposits; Parag Milk Foods quadruples paneer capacity; AceVector/Snapdeal IPO launches September 25 at Rs 1,741 crore valuation; authorities amplify fake goods scrutiny ahead of festive season; Delhi HC orders removal of misidentified activist posts.

bullets.text: Supreme Court proposes common investment platform for money deposited by litigants in courts to improve returns.
Parag Milk Foods quadrupling paneer capacity from 20 MT to 80 MT per day across retail, e-commerce, and HoReCa channels.
AceVector (Snapdeal parent) IPO launches September 25; raising Rs 287 crore fresh capital, Rs 1,741 crore valuation sought.
Authorities amplifying online fake goods scrutiny ahead of festive shopping rush with increased seller and import inspections.
Delhi High Court: journalist Sudhir Chaudhary removed posts misidentifying CJP protest activist following court directive.
